description: React component for a toolbar in a Kanban board application, including functions for downloading templates, managing modals for adding columns and bulk uploading cards via Excel files, and toggling fullscreen mode.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate
methods.description: Creates and downloads an Excel template for Kanban cards with predefined columns and a sample task.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Opens modal to add a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of new column, adds it via useKanban hook, and shows toast notifications.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Reads uploaded Excel file, extracts data, and shows modal for column selection.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Processes selected column and entries from Excel, maps data to card objects, and performs bulk insert.
